sources.title: Model capability ranking from public benchmarks and community consensus
sources.content:
Based on public benchmarks (MMLU, HumanEval, MATH, GPQA, etc.) and community consensus as of 2026-08, the relative capability ranking of the candidate models is as follows:

=== Tier 1: Frontier Models ===
1. gpt-5.6-sol - The strongest model in the pool. Top-tier reasoning, coding, math, and general knowledge. Supports max reasoning effort. Best for complex tasks requiring deep reasoning and synthesis.
2. gpt-5.6-terra - Very strong model, slightly below sol. Excellent reasoning, coding, and math. Supports max reasoning effort. Good for complex tasks and as a judge/synthesizer.
3. gpt-5.6-luna - Strong model with good balance of speed and capability. Supports max reasoning effort. Good for most tasks including reasoning and coding.

=== Tier 2: Strong Models ===
4. gpt-5.5 - Solid performer across most benchmarks. Supports up to xhigh reasoning effort. Good for general tasks and as a reference model.
5. deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro - DeepSeek's latest pro model. Strong on coding and math. Good latency characteristics.
6. mistralai/mistral-large-3-675b-instruct-2512 - Mistral's large model. Strong on multilingual tasks and general reasoning.
7. deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash - DeepSeek's fast model. Good for low-latency tasks and simple verification.
8. openai/gpt-oss-120b - OpenAI's open-source 120B model. Good general capabilities. Supports reasoning effort.

=== Tier 3: Capable Models ===
9. nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b - NVIDIA's 120B MoE model. Good for general tasks.
10. minimaxai/minimax-m3 - MiniMax's latest model. Competitive on Chinese language tasks.
11. minimaxai/minimax-m2.7 - MiniMax's previous generation. Decent general capabilities.
12. stepfun-ai/step-3.7-flash - StepFun's fast model. Good for simple tasks.
13. stepfun-ai/step-3.5-flash - StepFun's previous fast model.
14. z-ai/glm-5.2 - Zhipu AI's GLM model. Strong on Chinese language tasks.
15. openai/gpt-oss-20b - OpenAI's smaller open-source model. Good for lightweight tasks.

=== Tier 4: Lightweight/Specialized Models ===
16. nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning - NVIDIA's nano reasoning model.
17. nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b - NVIDIA's nano model.
18. nvidia/llama-3.1-nemotron-nano-8b-v1 - Lightweight NVIDIA model.
19. nvidia/llama-3.1-nemotron-nano-vl-8b-v1 - Lightweight vision-language model.
20. nvidia/nemotron-mini-4b-instruct - Very small model for simple tasks.

=== Reasoning Capability Notes ===
gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna: support low/medium/high/xhigh/max reasoning effort via responses_reasoning transport
gpt-5.5, gpt-5.2: support low/medium/high/xhigh reasoning effort via responses_reasoning transport
openai/gpt-oss-120b, openai/gpt-oss-20b: support low/medium/high reasoning effort via chat_reasoning_effort transport
Most other models: limited or no explicit reasoning effort support

=== Role Recommendations ===
- primary_solver: gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna
- independent_solver: gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5, deepseek-v4-pro
- critic: gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5
- judge: gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra
- synthesizer: gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra
- domain_specialist: gpt-5.6-luna, minimax-m3, glm-5.2
- structured_extraction: gpt-5.5, deepseek-v4-flash, gpt-oss-120b
- short_verification: deepseek-v4-flash, gpt-oss-20b, nemotron-mini-4b
- simple_classification: deepseek-v4-flash, gpt-oss-20b, nemotron-mini-4b
- single_tool_argument_validation: gpt-5.5, deepseek-v4-flash
